ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: tidy after months of not standing a mess
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Months of not standing a mess have settled into {PAWN_objective} for good: {PAWN_pronoun} cleans quickly and well, and a filthy room still puts {PAWN_objective} out of sorts.

plain.li: I don't decide to clean anymore. I just find the cloth in my hand.

warm.li: A clean room is a kind of welcome. I keep ours that way for everyone.

blunt.li: Mess is a choice. I don't make it.

cheerful.li: Everything in its place and a shine on the table! This is who I am now.

gloomy.li: I can't leave a mess alone anymore. It used to be a habit. Now it's just me.

cold.li: Order is no longer something I impose. It is how I work.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: neat after months of not standing a mess

cold.li: Order is no longer something I impose. It is how I work.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a green thumb from talking to the plants
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After seasons of tending the fields and talking to every plant in them, {PAWN_pronoun} knows what each one wants. The work goes faster, and a little more comes of it.

plain.li: I can tell what a plant needs by looking at it now. Water, shade, or just to be left alone.

warm.li: The fields feel like old friends. I think they'd say the same about me.

blunt.li: Plants grow when I'm around. That's all I know.

cheerful.li: The corn's taller this year and I'm taking all the credit!

gloomy.li: The plants are the only things here that do what I hope they will.

cold.li: I have learned the crops' requirements well enough that the work is mostly reflex.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a born cook, from singing at the stove
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: All those meals and all those songs at the stove: the kitchen is where {PAWN_pronoun} belongs now. {PAWN_pronoun} cooks quickly, and hardly anyone gets sick from it.

plain.li: I know the stove's moods now, which pot burns and which corner stays cool.

warm.li: Feeding everyone is how I look after them. I've never been better at anything.

cheerful.li: New song, new stew, and nobody's been sick in weeks! The kitchen's mine.

gloomy.li: The stove is the one place I'm sure of myself.

cold.li: Repetition has made the cooking efficient and clean. The results speak for themselves.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: an animal friend, from naming every animal
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Every animal here has a name {PAWN_pronoun} gave it, and they know {PAWN_objective} for it. Wild ones tame and tame ones learn more easily for {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: The animals come when I call. Not the others. Me.

warm.li: Every animal here knows my voice. I'd like to think they're glad of it.

blunt.li: Animals trust me. I don't waste it.

cheerful.li: The goat follows me everywhere now. So does the other goat. And the dog.

gloomy.li: The animals don't ask anything of me I can't give. People do.

cold.li: The animals respond to me reliably now. Consistency is most of it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: an animal lover, from naming every animal
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Every animal here has a name {PAWN_pronoun} gave it, and they know {PAWN_objective} for it.

plain.li: The animals come when I call. Not the others. Me.

warm.li: Every animal here knows my voice. I'd like to think they're glad of it.

blunt.li: Animals trust me. I don't waste it.

cheerful.li: The goat follows me everywhere now. So does the other goat. And the dog.

gloomy.li: The animals don't ask anything of me I can't give. People do.

cold.li: The animals respond to me reliably now. Consistency is most of it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: healer's hands, from steady hands kept busy
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: So many wounds tended that {PAWN_possessive} hands know the work by themselves: {PAWN_pronoun} tends faster and better than before.

plain.li: I closed a wound today without thinking about it. My hands knew before I did.

warm.li: When someone's hurt they ask for me now. I'll always come.

blunt.li: Good at this now. Keep the bandages stocked.

cheerful.li: Stitches straight as a ruler! I've found my calling, even if it's a messy one.

gloomy.li: I'm good at mending people. We've given me plenty of practice.

cold.li: My tending is fast and clean now. Practice did what instruction couldn't.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: trail-wise, from knowing every trail
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_pronoun} knows the land around the colony like {PAWN_possessive} own room. Animals rarely see {PAWN_objective} coming.

plain.li: I can tell which way the wind will turn by the trees. The deer never hear me now.

warm.li: I know this land well enough to bring anyone home from it.

blunt.li: I see them first. Every time.

cheerful.li: I snuck up on a rabbit today just to say hello. It was very surprised.

gloomy.li: The land and I understand each other. It's easier than people.

cold.li: I move through the land without disturbing it. The hunt is mostly patience now.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: harder working, from humming through the days
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer {TRAIT}. Months of humming through the work have done it.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Months of humming through long days of work: the work has become something {PAWN_pronoun} likes doing.

plain.li: The days go by in a tune now. I look up and the work's done.

warm.li: I like being the one who keeps going. It lets the others rest.

blunt.li: Work gets done. I do it.

cheerful.li: Another day, another tune, another pile of work finished. I love it!

gloomy.li: Work fills the quiet. I don't stop now.

cold.li: I find I no longer need rest as often as I took it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: kind, from remembering every birthday
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: A year of remembering everyone's day: {PAWN_pronoun} has a good word for most people now, and never an insult.

plain.li: I know everyone's birthday and most of their worries. It's hard to be sharp with people you know that well.

warm.li: Remembering the little things is how I love the people here. It's become all of me.

blunt.li: People matter. I act like it.

cheerful.li: There's always someone to celebrate, if you're paying attention!

gloomy.li: Somebody should remember. I'd hate for anyone here to be forgotten.

cold.li: Kindness costs little and buys a great deal. I practice it now without deciding to.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a night owl, from keeping late hours
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Months of late hours have turned {PAWN_objective} around for good: {PAWN_pronoun} is at {PAWN_possessive} best at night and sorry to be up by day. Give {PAWN_objective} the night shift.

plain.li: Daylight feels like someone else's time now. The night is mine.

warm.li: I keep watch while they sleep. I wouldn't trade it.

blunt.li: Nights. Not days. Schedule me accordingly.

cheerful.li: Good morning! It's midnight. Best part of the day.

gloomy.li: The sun's too loud. The dark understands me.

cold.li: My body has settled on the night. I've stopped arguing with it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: tough, after surviving wound after wound
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Downed, laid up and patched back together more than once, {PAWN_pronoun} has come out harder to hurt: blows that would floor others glance off {PAWN_objective} now.

plain.li: I've been knocked down enough times to know I get back up. My body seems to know it too.

warm.li: Every time they carried me in, someone sat with me. I'm tougher for it, and I owe them.

blunt.li: Takes more than that to put me down now.

cheerful.li: Scars on scars, and still standing! I'm practically made of leather.

gloomy.li: I don't feel the hits like I used to. I'm not sure what that says about me.

cold.li: Injury no longer stops me as it did. The body has adapted.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: quicker on their feet after a season of hauling
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer a {TRAIT}. A season of carrying loads across the colony has quickened {PAWN_possessive} step.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: A season of carrying loads from one end of the colony to the other has quickened {PAWN_possessive} step.

plain.li: I walk the colony faster than anyone now. I know every shortcut between the stockpiles.

warm.li: If anything needs carrying, I'm already on my way.

blunt.li: Faster on my feet. Fewer wasted hours.

cheerful.li: I raced the dog to the stockpile today. I won! Mostly.

gloomy.li: All that hauling got me something, at least. Quick legs.

cold.li: My pace has increased with the distance covered. A predictable adaptation.
